people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

translations.web: Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh, “For”, he said, “God has made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.”
translations.bsb: Joseph named the firstborn Manasseh, saying, “God has made me forget all my hardship and all my father’s household.”
translations.kjv: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For God, said he, hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father's house.
translations.asv: And Joseph called the name of the first-born Manasseh: For, said he, God hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father's house.
